voter_id: Voters shouldn't have to show photo ID; signature checks and other methods are enough.
Voters should show ID, but many kinds should count, IDs should be free, and people without one should have a backup way to vote.
Voters should show a photo ID, with free IDs for anyone who needs one, and no backup option.
Voters should show a government-issued photo ID, with no backup option.
proof_of_citizenship: People registering to vote shouldn't have to show proof of citizenship; the sworn statement and existing checks are enough.
People should have to show proof of citizenship only when government records can't confirm it.
Everyone registering to vote should have to show a passport, birth certificate or similar document.
mail_voting: Every voter should get a mail ballot automatically.
Any voter who asks should be able to vote by mail.
Only voters with a reason, like illness or travel, should be able to vote by mail.
Almost everyone should vote in person, not by mail.
mail_ballot_deadline: Mail ballots postmarked by Election Day should count if they arrive within a week or more.
Mail ballots postmarked by Election Day should count if they arrive within 3 days.
Only mail ballots received by Election Day should count.
auto_registration: Eligible citizens should be registered to vote automatically when they deal with agencies like the DMV, unless they opt out.
Agencies should offer voter registration, but people have to choose to sign up.
People should register to vote on their own.
felony_voting: People convicted of a felony should always be able to vote, even while in prison.
People convicted of a felony should be able to vote once they're released from prison.
People convicted of a felony should be able to vote after finishing parole or probation.
People convicted of a felony should vote again only after a waiting period or an individual review.
People convicted of a felony should never vote again.
electoral_college: The president should be elected by national popular vote, ending the Electoral College.
Keep the Electoral College, but split each state's electoral votes in proportion to how the state voted.
Keep the Electoral College as it is.
popular_vote_loser: A candidate who gets fewer votes nationwide should never be able to win the presidency.
Winning the presidency with fewer votes is acceptable, but the system should change to make it rarer.
Winning the presidency with fewer votes is fine; it reflects the states' role in choosing the president.
redistricting: Independent commissions with no politicians should draw congressional districts.
Commissions with equal members from both parties should draw congressional districts.
State legislatures should draw districts once every 10 years, after the census.
State legislatures should be able to redraw districts whenever they choose, including mid-decade.
campaign_spending: Election spending by corporations, unions and the wealthy should be strictly limited, by constitutional amendment if needed.
There shouldn't be spending limits, but who pays for political ads should be fully disclosed.
There shouldn't be limits or disclosure rules; spending on politics is free speech.
public_financing: Candidates who accept spending limits should get public money matching small donations several times over.
Candidates who accept spending limits should get a modest amount of public money.
congress_term_limits: Members of Congress should be limited to 12 years or less in each chamber.
Members of Congress should be limited to about 18 to 24 years in each chamber.
Members of Congress shouldn't have term limits; voters can remove them.
court_term_limits: Future Supreme Court justices should serve 18-year terms.
Future justices should serve fixed terms of around 25 years.
Supreme Court justices should keep serving for life.
ranked_choice: All elections should use ranked-choice voting.
Each state or city should decide whether to use ranked-choice voting.
statehood: This should become a state only if its residents vote for it: {case}.
voting_age: 17-year-olds should be able to vote if they'll be 18 by the next general election.
The voting age should stay at 18.
noncitizen_local_voting: Green card holders should be able to vote in local elections, like school board races.
Each city should decide whether green card holders can vote in local elections.
Noncitizens voting in local elections should be banned everywhere.
